caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling an elongated, paddle-like tool with a handle and a bulbous end. The object is oriented horizontally, with the handle on the left and the bulbous, intricately detailed head on the right. The handle is cylindrical with alternating dark and light linear shading to suggest a wooden texture, ending in a rounded knob. Moving rightward, a band separates the handle from the broader head, which consists of two large, curved, leaf-like elements that encase the bulbous body. These elements feature an alternating pattern of dark and light curved stripes, creating a visually prominent striped appearance. Two straight, protruding extensions emerge symmetrically from either side of the bulbous end, resembling handles. The drawing uses mostly shades of brown, gray, and white on a beige paper background, with pencil and gray watercolor washes providing highlights and shadows to suggest three-dimensionality. There is a small, horizontal scale at the lower left of the image indicating measurements, and a handwritten label or signature appears at the bottom right.
title: Bellows Bottle
